title: Bye Bye, Earth
description: Belle Lablac doesn’t really fit in as the only human being in a world full of anthropomorphic animals. No fangs, no fur, no scales, no claws. Lonely and eager to discover where she comes from, Belle journeys to find answers to the questions of her heart. Carrying nothing but her giant sword, the Runding, she faces a world of possibilities and pitfalls in hopes of discovering the truth.

episodes_data.title: Bye Bye, Earth Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Villagers call on a wandering swordsman to rid them of a lake monster, but he sends his apprentice: a girl like none of them have ever seen. She may know how to fight, but can she ever feel at home in a world that sees her as a freak?

episodes_data.title: Bye Bye, Earth Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Belle must fight before royalty, the divine, and all of Park City to earn the privilege of going on her nomad's journey. The very first step of that journey, however, may be closer to home than she realizes.

episodes_data.title: Bye Bye, Earth Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: With her first divinely appointed duty behind her, Belle waits impatiently for a second call to arms. She explores Park City in the meantime, until a chance meeting with the enigmatic solist Adonis piques her curiosity.

episodes_data.title: Bye Bye, Earth Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Belle and Adonis march into the Katakombe in pursuit of the rebel solist Tiziano, only for their mismatched band to charge straight into a trap. Belle must make unlikely allies to avoid a watery grave.

episodes_data.title: Bye Bye, Earth Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Cornered by Tiziano's army of corpses, solists from both sides join forces for survival. But how long can their ragtag band last against an enemy who's already decimated an army?

episodes_data.title: Bye Bye, Earth Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: The encounter with Sherry triggers unknown feelings in Belle. The topic of "love" is in the air. Meanwhile, Adonis dares to conduct an experiment with the broken swords Legna and Lived. (Azanime)

episodes_data.title: Bye Bye, Earth Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: To express her gratitude, Sherry invites Belle and company to a ball at the palace where things take an unexpected and sinister turn. (Azanime)

episodes_data.title: Bye Bye, Earth Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: At long last, Belle attempts her final trial to become a nomad. Confronted with a strange instrument, she must face her own doubts. Meanwhile, Adonis comes face-to-face with a chilling revelation.

episodes_data.title: Bye Bye, Earth Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: While Belle struggles through her trauma, Adonis sinks into darkness. There, he meets the swordwright Dram and Belle's teacher, Sian. Learning of their shared path awakens him to a terrible new power.

episodes_data.title: Bye Bye, Earth Season 2 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Gwyn and his band press farther into the castle depths, fending off danger and treachery from all sides.
